sentences.text:
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
December 6, 2024 40 Ardr Crr 4022 of 2024 Ranjit Kumar Das & anr.
Vs. The State of West Bengal & ors.
Adv. Ramashis Mukherjee, Adv. Debanjana Sen, ...for the petitioners.

The petitioners who are the parents in law of the private opposite party seek quashing of proceedings being G.R. case no. 6222 of 2020 pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Baruipur, South 24 Parganas.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Baruipur, South 24 Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the present complaint is a retaliation of complaints filed by their daughter Mitali Das against the private opposite party and others under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and also a case under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005.

entities.text: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The case has been quashed by this Court qua the co-accused.
It appears on perusal of the material on record that the matter needs to be heard on merits.
The petitioners are directed to serve copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Let the matter appear under the heading 'Contested Application' in the monthly list of March, 2025.

Further proceedings of G.R. case no. 6222 of 2020 pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Baruipur, South 24 Parganas be stayed qua the petitioners till 31st March, 2025 or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
